notes.title: Forsaken Island – Patch v1.0.9: Cursed Depths Update
notes.notes:
This update brings a mix of gameplay refinements, quality-of-life improvements, and critical bug fixes to enhance your survival adventure as Captain Elias Blackbone.
New & Improved
Improved Bonecrafting Feedback – Added visual and audio cues when attaching or swapping limbs. Now you’ll feel the upgrade!
[list]
[*] Campfire Interaction Rework – Streamlined crafting and resting at campfires with better UI prompts and easier resource selection.
[*] Expanded Exploration Logs – Discover new journal entries that hint at the island’s darker mysteries and cursed history.
[*] Combat Flow Tweaks – Enemy attack patterns adjusted for more strategic pacing in early-to-mid game encounters.
[/list]
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could lose equipped limbs after loading a save.
[*] Resolved camera stutter during sprinting on uneven terrain.
[*] Corrected several environment collisions causing players to get stuck near the Sunken Graveyard.
[*] Fixed enemy spawning bugs in the Ashen Crater zone.
[/list]
Performance & Polish
[list]
[*] Reduced lighting pop-in on dynamic foliage.
[*] Updated ambient audio zones for better transitions between biomes.
[/list]
[b]Stay sharp, Captain. The island remembers every bone you bury…
[/b]
More content and narrative paths are coming soon. Your journey has only just begun.
